items.html: *The third correction is the membrane of the air, that was clarified and sealed. For it was clarified so that the light of the air within the skull could pass through this membrane, to shine in the concealed brain; but nevertheless it is sealed, for the light was diminished, and that brain is able to receive it, unlike if it had been open. And within this membrane the Tifferet of Atik clothes, for the covering membrane is similar to the firmament, which is Tifferet.
